fields.description: Issue includes extensive editorial coverage of the 1935 Florida Keys hurricane and the deaths of World War veterans in government camps, criticizing warnings and evacuation delays. Local political reporting covers the Hialeah municipal election and discussion of federal savings and loan practices. Additional content includes a report on a flight to survey hurricane damage in the Keys, a feature on Miami traffic fatalities with police statistics, society/column items, horse-racing notes, and a Miami Life contest feature naming Miss Evelyn Butler as a working-girl contest winner.
